description: Test suite for the HealthMonitor component, including mock agent client, setup functions, and various unit tests for agent registration, health checks, MCP health, concurrency, and recovery.

classes.name: mockAgentClient
classes.description: Mock implementation of an agent client for testing, simulating responses and errors for agent status and MCP health.

methods.name: newMockAgentClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new mock agent client instance.

methods.name: GetAgentStatus
methods.description: Simulates retrieving agent status, returning predefined responses or errors.

methods.name: GetMCPHealth
methods.description: Simulates retrieving MCP health status, returning predefined responses or errors.

methods.name: RestartMCPServer
methods.description: Simulates restarting MCP server, always returns nil.

methods.name: GetMCPTools
methods.description: Simulates retrieving MCP tools, returns nil.

methods.name: ShutdownAgent
methods.description: Simulates shutting down an agent, returns nil.

methods.name: setStatusResponse
methods.description: Sets a successful status response for a specific node.

methods.name: setStatusError
methods.description: Sets an error response for a specific node's status.

methods.name: setMCPHealthResponse
methods.description: Sets a MCP health response for a specific node.

methods.name: getStatusCallCountFor
methods.description: Returns the number of times GetAgentStatus was called for a node.

methods.name: getMCPHealthCallCountFor
methods.description: Returns the number of times GetMCPHealth was called for a node.
